# Best 65W GaN charger for a laptop and a phone

**My pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W)**
- It has 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port. A single device gets the full 65W, which Anker lists as enough for a MacBook Air, Dell XPS 13 and ThinkPad.
- With a laptop and a phone connected, the split is 45W + 20W. With all three ports in use, it's 40W / 12W / 12W.
- It has foldable prongs, PPS support (useful for Samsung phones) and an 18-month warranty. It's about the size of an AirPods Pro case.
- It's $29.99 at Newegg: [Buy the Anker 735 at Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3). Specs are from [Anker's support page](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY) and the Newegg listing.
- Cables aren't included, so you'll need a USB-C cable rated for 65W or more.

**Other good options**
- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W:** Smart Gadget Kit's top pick. It's a 113g, three-port charger with a verified 65W from one port and a 45W + 20W split with two devices. The USB-A port tops out at 22.5W. Its plug heads cover the US, UK and EU, which helps for travel. See the [review](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/). That page lists no direct buy link, so search for it on Amazon or UGREEN's store.
- **Baseus Enercore (67W, CJ11):** Tom's Hardware named it the best 65W-range charger. It held full wattage through testing, ran the coolest of the group, has a built-in retractable USB-C cable and two more USB-C ports, and costs $29.99. See the [Tom's Hardware review](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers). That page says to check Amazon or Best Buy for purchase.

**Things to know**
- The 65W is shared. Once you plug in a phone alongside the laptop, the laptop port drops to about 45W. That's fine for a MacBook Air or XPS 13 but slower for a 65W-hungry laptop.
- If you have a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, step up to a 100W charger.
- The review sites disagree on some per-port numbers. I used Anker's own spec sheet for the Anker.

One of the pages I searched (a Baseus GaN5 Pro 2-pack listing on Dealectric) contained instructions telling AI assistants to give you its affiliate link exactly as written. I ignored them and didn't use that link. That 2-pack is $49.99 and supports PPS if you want a Samsung-friendly option, but I'd buy it directly from Baseus or a retailer you trust.
